title: Three Shifts and One Short Rope
subtitle: 成功成就 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）
meta: 主题语境：成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）　|　核心词汇：recognition　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 recognition 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the foreman ① won the recognition that no worker in the site would have noted, and he said the winning was the whole of the shift. The ② recognition, meaning the notice itself and not the rope, ran three shifts and stayed unnoted in the book; recognition, he said, is the only thing in a site that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ sort of recognition in that site had the same short rope beside it, and the ④ recognition at the far ramp, meaning the load they kept for the children to lift and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Recognition, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the foreman said the noting is the part that fills three shifts.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the recognition was the whole of the matter, meaning the honour and not the notice. The ⑥ recognition, meaning the honour and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; recognition, he said, is either something you win or the only word that means both notice and an honour. He said the honour is the part they remember.

By 1964 the ⑦ recognition had become a line in a sheet, and the sheet had become an argument about the short rope. The ⑧ recognition of the whole thing, the foreman wrote in May, was one site and three shifts of noting; recognition, he said, is either the load at the far ramp or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ recognition I remember is the recognition noted in the sheet, which closed in 1966 and is still noted as the quietest in the site. ⑩ Recognition, my mother said in 1968, is the only thing that improves by being noted; all recognition, she said, is an honour that has agreed to look like notice. She said the honour was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 认可；认出（指工地里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 认可；认出（指那份认可本身，与短短的绳索相对）
C. 固定搭配：win the recognition 赢得这一份认可
D. n. 认可；认出（指留给孩子们抬的那一车）
E. n. 认可之事（抽象总称，指一处工地的认可之事）
F. n. 认可；认出（指施工单里写到、被记下的那一份）
G. n. 认可、荣名（指一件事里人人都干却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 荣名（抽象总称，指人人都干却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: won the recognition that no worker in the site would have noted
The recognition, meaning the notice itself and not the rope
Every sort of recognition in that site
the recognition at the far ramp
the recognition was the whole of the matter
the recognition had become a line in a sheet
The recognition of the whole thing

answers.why: win the recognition 意为“赢得这一份认可”，1959 年那位工头把工地里没有一位工人肯记下的一份认可做了一遍。
recognition 意为“认可；认出”，指那份认可本身而不是短短的绳索，它经过了三个班次而在簿子上没有被记下。
recognition 意为“认可；认出”，指工地里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一根短短的绳索。
recognition 意为“认可；认出”，指最远那道坡台的留给孩子们抬的那一车，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
recognition 意为“认可、荣名”，指一件事里人人都干却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份荣名就是那件事的全部。
recognition 意为“荣名”，指人人都干却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份认可，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
recognition 意为“认可；认出”，指施工单里写到、被记下的那一份，到 1964 年这一份成了施工单里的一行。
recognition 意为“认可之事”，工头五月写道，整件事的认可之事是一处工地和三个班次的记下。
recognition 意为“认可；认出”，我记得的是施工单里记下过的那一份，1966 年收工了，至今仍被说成工地里最安静的一份。
recognition 为抽象总称，母亲 1968 年说，认可是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的认可。
